title: Improving the Ability of a Laser Ultrasonic Wave-Based Detection of Damage on the Curved Surface of a Pipe Using a Deep Learning Technique.
summary: A pretrained COCO EfficientDet-d0 was fine-tuned on 1,280 laser-ultrasonic waveform-propagation images from artificially damaged curved pipe; reported mAP exceeded the pretrained baseline. This is a specific laboratory pipe-damage detection result, limited to the specimens and data collected.
ai_technology: Transfer learning applies EfficientDet-d0 to UWPI images; Methods §§2.3–2.4.
